name: Dirt Road, Black Fortress Gate
desc1: This wide dirt road travels through what appears to be a field of
desc2: tall black weeds. The strange-looking plants are set in even rows,
desc3: however, and obviously some sort of crop. The dirt road continues
desc4: through the field to the west. To the east, the road enters the
desc5: gatehouse of a massive black fortress, its dark stone walls sheer and
desc6: solidly built. There us something foreboding about this castle,
